spans: COMMENCEMENT DATE FOR MAINTENANCE UNDER THIS ADDENDUM:  MARCH 1, 2001

THIS MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT IS GOVERNED BY, AND SHALL BE SUBJECT TO, THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THE MASTER AGREEMENT BETWEEN NETZEE AND BANKERS BANK, INCLUDING THE LIMITED WARRANTY AND DISCLAIMER AND LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY PROVIDED THEREIN. SUCH TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE HEREBY AFFIRMED BY BOTH PARTIES AND INCORPORATED BY REFERENCE IN THIS MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT, INCLUDING, WITHOUT LIMITATION, ALL LICENSES GRANTED OR EXERCISABLE THEREUNDER.
The maintenance is for a period of one (1) year commencing upon expiration of the initial one (1) year term of the License/Services Schedule.
COMMENCEMENT DATE FOR MAINTENANCE UNDER THIS ADDENDUM:  MARCH 1, 2001

SUCH TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE HEREBY AFFIRMED BY BOTH PARTIES AND INCORPORATED BY REFERENCE IN THIS MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT, INCLUDING, WITHOUT LIMITATION, ALL LICENSES GRANTED OR EXERCISABLE THEREUNDER.
Bankers Bank agrees to pay fees equal to $40 per month for all Participating Banks (original or added) for which maintenance is provided.

notes: The contract states no execution date, so Agreement Date is answered with the stated maintenance commencement date (borderline); the one-year maintenance term running from that date gives the computed expiration of 03/01/2002. Cap on Liability and License Grant are borderline Yes calls resting on the affirmation and incorporation by reference of the Master Agreement's limitations of liability and licences, while Governing Law is No because that same clause names the Master Agreement rather than any state or country.
